subject: psychology

moments.title: Psychology as the Behaviourist Views It
moments.body: Watson's Psychological Review paper sets behaviourism's agenda: study only behaviour, abandon introspection.

quote.text: Give me a dozen healthy infants... and I'll guarantee to take any one at random and train him to become any type of specialist I might select.

moments.takeaway: A manifesto can redirect a field for decades.

moments.title: The Little Albert experiment
moments.body: Watson and Rayner condition an 11-month-old infant to fear a white rat by pairing it with a loud noise. Ethics and methodology are disputed.
moments.takeaway: Iconic studies often turn out to be methodologically thinner than textbook accounts.

moments.title: Behaviourism revised edition
moments.body: Forced from academia after a scandal, Watson works in advertising, carrying behaviourist methods into consumer research.
moments.takeaway: Behaviourism shaped advertising as much as psychology.

now.title: Behaviourism's afterlife
now.body: Applied behaviour analysis, CBT and reinforcement learning in AI all carry behaviourist methods forward.
now.open_questions: Where do behaviourist explanations remain sufficient, and where are cognitive constructs unavoidable?

reflection: Watson's confidence about the malleability of behaviour set the tone for an era.
